text: きが　みじかくて　すぐどなるし　あのバアさん　こわすぎるよ…

structure.jp: あのバアさん　こわすぎるよ…
structure.en: that old lady is way too scary...

patterns.name: 〜すぎる
patterns.explanation: すぎる stuck onto a describing word, with its last い dropped, says there is too much of it. こわすぎる = 'is too scary'.

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し after a statement gives it as one reason among others for what comes next. すぐどなるし = 'she yells right away, and so'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The くて ending on a describing word means 'and', joining it to what follows. きが　みじかくて = 'she's short-tempered and'.
